en: Genesis 10

p.src: 1  Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

ja: たち、セム、ハム、ヤペテの
en: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
u.src: 1  Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

p.src: 2  The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

ja: たちは、ゴメル、マゴグ、マダイ、ヤワン、トバル、メシェク、ティラスである。
en: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
u.src: 2  The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

p.src: 3  The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

ja: たちは、アシュケナズ、リファト、トガルマである。
en: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
u.src: 3  The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

p.src: 4  The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

ja: たちは、エリシャ、タルシシュ、キティム、ドダニムである。
en: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
u.src: 4  The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

p.src: 5  Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

ja: が、それぞれ自分たちの土
かれていった。彼らは、それぞれの
en: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
u.src: 5  Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

p.src: 6  The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

ja: たちは、クシュ、ミツライム、プト、カナンである。
en: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
u.src: 6  The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

p.src: 7  The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

ja: たちは、セバ、ハビラ、サブタ、ラアマ、サブテカである。ラアマの息
たちは、シェバとデダンである。
en: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
u.src: 7  The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

p.src: 8  Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

ja: クシュはニムロドの父となった。ニムロドは
en: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.
u.src: 8  Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

p.src: 9  He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.
u.src: 9  He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

p.src: 10  The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

ja: にあるバベル、エレク、アッカド、カルネであった。
en: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
u.src: 10  The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

p.src: 11  Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

ja: き、ニネベ、レホボト・イル、カラ、
en: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
u.src: 11  Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

p.src: 12  and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

ja: そしてニネベとカラの
en: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
u.src: 12  and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

p.src: 13  Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

ja: ミツライムは、ルディム、アナミム、レハビム、ナフトヒム、
en: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
u.src: 13  Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

p.src: 14  Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

ja: パトルシム、カスルヒム、カフトリムの父となった。ペリシテ
en: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
u.src: 14  Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

p.src: 15  Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

en: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
u.src: 15  Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

p.src: 16  the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
u.src: 16  the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

p.src: 17  the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
u.src: 17  the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

p.src: 18  the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
u.src: 18  the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

p.src: 19  The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

ja: は、シドンからゲラルに
り、さらにソドム、ゴモラ、アデマ、ツェボイムに
en: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
u.src: 19  The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

p.src: 20  These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

ja: たちであり、それぞれの
en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
u.src: 20  These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

p.src: 21  Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

ja: の父であり、ヤペテの兄であるセムにも、
en: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
u.src: 21  Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

p.src: 22  The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

ja: たちは、エラム、アシュル、アルパクシャド、ルデ、アラムである。
en: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
u.src: 22  The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

p.src: 23  The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

ja: たちは、ウツ、フル、ゲテル、マシュである。
en: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
u.src: 23  The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

p.src: 24  Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

ja: アルパクシャドはシェラの父となり、シェラはエベルの父となった。
en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
u.src: 24  Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

p.src: 25  To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

ja: はペレグであった。彼の
けられたからである。彼の
en: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
u.src: 25  To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

p.src: 26  Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

ja: ヨクタンは、アルモダド、シェレフ、ハツァルマベト、エラ、
en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
u.src: 26  Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

p.src: 27  Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

ja: ハドラム、ウザル、ディクラ、
en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
u.src: 27  Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

p.src: 28  Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

ja: オバル、アビマエル、シェバ、
en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
u.src: 28  Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

p.src: 29  Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

ja: オフィル、ハビラ、ヨバブの父となった。これらは皆、ヨクタンの息
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
u.src: 29  Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

p.src: 30  Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

ja: であるセファルへ向かう地域であった。
en: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
u.src: 30  Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

p.src: 31  These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

ja: たちであり、それぞれの
en: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
u.src: 31  These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

p.src: 32  These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.
u.src: 32  These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.
